title: reports
summary: A standalone Python script (test_sdv.py) that loads a tabular dataset, lets the user select columns, builds SDV metadata, and trains a synthesizer to generate synthetic rows. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer end-to-end, fitting it on selected columns and sampling synthetic data.
evidence: test_sdv.py:136 'model = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer()' followed by model.fit(df_selected) and model.sample(num_rows=num_rows)
